hero.headline: Software shaped carefully—clear interfaces, fewer moving parts.
hero.lede: Luddite Labs builds durable products and platforms for teams who value craft over hype.

promise.title: We slow down where it matters so your software can move faster later.
paragraphs: Most teams do not need more frameworks. They need sharper boundaries, cleaner data, and interfaces people can trust under pressure.
We treat software like shop work: measure twice, cut once, leave the bench ready for the next craftsperson.

items.title: Product systems
items.body: End-to-end web products with sober IA, accessible UI, and performance that holds up in the wild.

items.title: Platform APIs
items.body: Contracts, versioning, and docs that partners can build against without tribal knowledge.

items.title: Operational tools
items.body: Internal consoles that cut noise, expose decisions, and respect the people on call.

cta.title: Bring us a hard problem.
cta.lede: If the brief is messy, good. That is usually where the real work starts.
